new_findings_for_future_discussion: Existing research cited Surya Deo, but lacked a dedicated bibliography and searchable identity. This is an observable coverage/indexing gap, not evidence that nobody had researched him.
Archive work can connect to future filmmaking: IFA describes Deo and Darai’s collaborative project. Frame this as a documented project rather than a completed recovery.
A multi-author anthology provides perspectives on music, women, Muslim identity, studios and distribution; chapter content must be read before adopting arguments.
The 2021 English Ollywood and Its Superstars retailer record and earlier English scholarship make unqualified first-English-book claims unsafe.
Research depth must include people who collected, published, donated and screened material; avoid sole-saviour accounts.
proposed_integration_not_applied: An annotated Reading Odia Cinema companion page, grouped by histories, criticism, songs and lives; short links from relevant chapters.
A focused story on people preserving cinema memory, potentially Surya Deo and the collaborative archive/screening network, connected to new production.
Book endmatter acknowledges existing scholarship, states what was actually consulted, and gives readers routes to explore further.
Read Patnaik’s future/economics argument and other relevant chapters before describing our livelihood-focused proposals as novel.
